carriersBlocked.reason: Site is up and out of maintenance, but the routing finder could not be driven. The place fields are React/JS-backed: setting the hidden RoutingFinderViewModel place codes alone fails client validation with "Place of Loading format is invalid", and setting the visible AutoCompletePOL and AutoCompletePOD inputs with synthetic input/change/blur events passes validation but the search posts back to an empty form with no results. A real autocomplete click sequence was attempted but the renderer wedged mid-interaction (Page.captureScreenshot timed out) and the page reloaded with the selection lost. Not a DataDome 403, so no POST quota was consumed and none was shared with liner-tracker-market-refresh.

notes: Evergreen coverage this run is 4 weeks, not 8, and only 4 of the planned lanes. durationWeek caps at 28 days and no second pass was run, so window weeks 42 to 45 are NOT covered by Evergreen. ShipmentLink closed the connection (ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED) after roughly four searches and again after the first vessel-schedule query; cooldowns of 20 to 60 seconds cleared it twice but it recurred, so the KRPUS-USNYC point search, all Gulf lanes and the TRITON vessel schedule were not retrieved. Hapag, Maersk, MSC and ONE all cover the full 8-week window.

Evergreen can be driven with no autocomplete seed: set tvs2OriAC / tvs2OriAC_hideValue and tvs2DesAC / tvs2DesAC_hideValue, call checkACViaUSCA on both, then frmSubmit. Confirmed again this run across four lanes. Declare script variables inside an IIFE - a bare var at top level collides with the previous call's binding and throws.

Maersk geo ids can be resolved from api.maersk.com/synergy/reference-data/geography/locations with cityName and the Consumer-Key captured from a routings-queries call, but the api-version header must start with 4 (api-version 1 fails OAS validation with an ECMA-262 regex error). Resolved this run: Shanghai 2IW9P6J7XAW72, Ningbo 104T898SJZ6GU, Busan 2XOHKM8FX8VI7, Savannah 0FW19NDUZ2NI7, Newark 02R2IYUF20M7Z, Yantian 0L3DBFFJ3KZ9A, Houston 183AKT65YAHRZ. USNYC is still rejected as a discharge geo on Asia lanes; USEWR is the working proxy. Several same-name candidates return HTTP 400 or 422, so test candidates against a live routing rather than trusting list order. Maersk also has no single-leg direct on CNYTN-USEWR or CNYTN-USSAV; those lanes are transhipment only.

MSC does not need the Alpine component method used on 13 Sep. Take searchCountryPortResults off the page component once for the PortId lookup, then POST JSON directly to /api/feature/tools/SearchSailingRoutes with body FromDate, fromPortId, toPortId, language, dataSourceId. Twelve lanes ran with no throttling. Service name is LoadingService, and IsDirectRoute separates direct from transhipment.

ONE moved its route finder. ecomm.one-line.com/one-ecom/schedule/routing-finder now 301s to www.one-line.com and returns Page Not Found; the live path is www.one-line.com/one-ecom/schedule/point-to-point-schedule. It accepts full URL parameters (oriLocCdParam, destLocCdParam, oriLocNmParam, destLocNmParam, frmDtParam, nextWeekValue 56, cargoNature GP, searchType List), so lanes can be driven by navigation alone with no UI interaction after the first seed search. Six lanes ran without hitting the "Thanks for Your Patience" ceiling, which is better than the documented three. Results are paginated 10 per page.

If a third AA9 voyage appears on a regular interval, retire this item and promote AA9 to the service registry.

alerts.detail: No first sighting this run. All three published items reappeared with identical dates and rotations, so there is no EXTRA LOADER DETECTED, no EXTRA LOADER UPDATED and no EXTRA LOADER GONE. Both detector fixtures passed. Hapag CNYTN-USNYC returned AA7 5 with isGemini false and US4 6 with isGemini true and flagged nothing, exactly as the regression baseline requires. Evergreen CNYTN-USNYC returned SAX 3, AUE 3 and CBX 5 and flagged nothing (TRITON has departed), and Evergreen CNNGB-USNYC returned NUE2 4, NUE 3 and OGEC 1 and flagged OGEC only.

ONE. Blocked on 13 Sep with what looked like a site-wide outage. The real cause was a URL change: the routing-finder path was retired and the page now lives at www.one-line.com/one-ecom/schedule/point-to-point-schedule. Six lanes were scanned with no session ceiling. Direct sailings returned only EC1, EC2 and EC4, all Premier Alliance registry codes, so Premier Alliance, Yang Ming and HMM tonnage is covered again.

CMA CGM. Scanned successfully two runs ago, blocked by planned maintenance on 13 Sep, and not retrievable this run for a different reason: the site is up but the routing finder rejects programmatic place selection and wedged the renderer during a real autocomplete click sequence. No lanes retrieved. This is not a DataDome 403 and consumed no POST quota. OOCL and APL tonnage, which is normally seen through CMA, is uncovered this run; OOCL is also independently blocked and was not attempted.

PS3 added to ignoredCodes. Seen once on ONE CNNGB-USNYC as a transhipment routing departing 21 Sep. PS3 is a Pacific Southwest string in the same family as the already-denied PS4, PS6 and PS8, it is a different trade, and the sighting was transhipment rather than a direct call, so it fails the extra-loader definition twice over. No other unknown code appeared on any of the 56 lane queries this run.

Lanes not covered this run: all CMA CGM lanes. Evergreen CNYTN-USHOU, CNSHA-USSAV, CNSHA-USHOU, CNNGB-USSAV, CNNGB-USHOU, KRPUS-USNYC, KRPUS-USSAV, KRPUS-USHOU, VNTOT-USNYC, VNTOT-USSAV, VNTOT-USHOU, CNTAO-USNYC and CNXMN-USNYC, plus the TRITON vessel schedule - all lost to ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED. Hapag CNNGB-USSAV and KRPUS-USSAV. Maersk VNVUT lanes and KRPUS-USSAV. MSC VNVUT-USSAV and VNVUT-USHOU. ONE CNSHA-USHOU, CNSHA-USSAV, CNNGB-USSAV, CNNGB-USHOU, KRPUS-USSAV, KRPUS-USHOU and all VNTOT lanes. In addition, Evergreen window weeks 42 to 45 are not covered at all because durationWeek caps at 28 days and no second pass was run.

Data correction in history. The Wan Hai AA9 eastbound CSV now carries two earlier calls for WAN HAI 712 E002 that earlier records did not hold, Port Klang North Port 22-23 Aug and Shekou 28-30 Aug. The retired history entry has been extended with those calls, its transit map updated, and its AA7 delta recomputed from -1 to 0. The voyage remains out of window and stays retired. Separately, the AA7 proforma baseline was re-measured from scratch this run and is a flat 38 days on CNNGB-USNYC across all eleven sailings that publish both ends, which reconfirms the AA9 delta of +1.
